label: LHG LTE6 kit
description: MikroTik LHG LTE6 kit (RBLHGR&R11e-LTE6) — 1x 100M RJ45, LTE radio. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: 802.3af/at** (12-57 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 6 W.
